description:
The diff added a docstring to every variant of TaskProperty (53 variants), TaskListProperty (15 variants), and TaskNotificationProperty (9 variants) in src/backend.rs, citing the exact spec section for each:

    /// The `freeBusyStatus` property, inherited from the JSCalendar JSTask object (RFC 8984 §4.4.2).
    FreeBusyStatus,

This is over 75 variants newly carrying a precise RFC-section anchor. A contributor implementing a backend method that needs to look up "what does freeBusyStatus mean per spec" no longer has to scan the whole RFC — the variant doc gives the exact §.

The inheritance distinction is preserved (JMAP additions cite draft-tasks-06; JSCalendar fields cite RFC 8984), so a reader can tell at a glance whether a field is owned by the JMAP draft or inherited from the underlying JSCalendar spec.

What someone might "simplify": "this is excessive, just put one doc comment at the top of the enum." Defend by pointing at the spec-coverage value: code-review on a future PR that touches `FreeBusyStatus` semantics can be done from the variant doc alone, without context-switching to the RFC index.

This is a contributor-quality-of-life win that pays compound interest as the crate ages and the next maintainer (who may not be the original author) inherits it.
title: Per-field RFC section anchors on TaskProperty / TaskListProperty / TaskNotificationProperty enum variants
